title: Galaxy reference data (builds, data tables, .loc files, data managers, IDC)
maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

formats.description: builds.txt: the static list of genome builds (dbkeys) Galaxy offers in its dbkey picker. Two TAB-separated columns, no header.
formats.record_key: dbkey (not unique: a dbkey may repeat with another display_name)

formats.description: .len file: one line per sequence, name TAB length. The __dbkeys__ table points to it (len_path); /api/genomes/{id} reads it.
formats.record_key: chrom (unique within one file)

formats.description: GET /api/genomes on a Galaxy server: JSON array of [display name, dbkey] pairs for every known build.
formats.record_key: [1] (dbkey; may repeat)

formats.description: GET /api/genomes/{dbkey} on a Galaxy server: the build's sequence names and lengths (from its .len file).
formats.record_key: id

formats.description: GET /api/tool_data/{table} on a Galaxy server: one data table's column names and all its rows (merged from every .loc file). One native record per row.
formats.record_key: name + fields[].value (value is meant to be unique per table, but duplicates are served)

formats.description: tool_data_table_conf.xml: declares each data table (name, column names, comment character, the .loc files or refgenie config that fill it). One native record per <table>.
formats.record_key: name (the same name may appear in several conf files; Galaxy merges them if the columns match)

formats.description: Galaxy all_fasta.loc: one FASTA file per row (data table all_fasta). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
formats.record_key: value (unique_build_id) within this table on one server

formats.description: Galaxy fasta_indexes.loc: samtools faidx-indexed FASTA per row (data table fasta_indexes). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
formats.record_key: value (unique_build_id) within this table on one server

formats.description: Galaxy bwa_mem_index.loc: BWA (0.6+/MEM) index prefix per row (data table bwa_mem_indexes). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
formats.record_key: value (unique_build_id) within this table on one server

formats.description: Galaxy bowtie2_indices.loc: Bowtie2 index basename per row (data table bowtie2_indexes). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
formats.record_key: value (unique_build_id) within this table on one server

formats.description: Galaxy rnastar_index2x_versioned.loc: STAR index directory per row. TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path, with_gene_model, version.
formats.record_key: value (unique_build_id) within this table on one server

formats.description: Galaxy dbkeys.loc (data table __dbkeys__): one dbkey per row with its .len file. TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, name, len_path.
formats.record_key: value (unique_build_id) within this table on one server

formats.description: Data manager output JSON: what a data manager tool writes so Galaxy can add rows to data tables. Paths are relative here; data_manager_conf.xml moves the files and rewrites them to absolute paths. One native record per entry.
formats.record_key: data_table + value

formats.description: RefgenieToolDataTable (lib/galaxy/tools/data/__init__.py): a data table with type="refgenie" is filled from a refgenie config instead of a .loc file. Each <field> is a Cheetah template over these variables. Prose/code only: there is no file of these records.
formats.record_key: __REFGENIE_UUID__ (refgenie:<genome>/<asset>:<tag>@<digest>)

formats.description: IDC genomes.yml (older pipeline): genomes to fetch and the indexers to run. cvmfs_current_managed/cvmfs_managed_genomes.yml uses the same entries inside a list of {genomes: [...]} blocks.
formats.record_key: id

formats.description: IDC data_managers.yml (older pipeline): data manager short name to Tool Shed tool id, tags that genomes.yml indexers refer to, and fixed parameters.
formats.record_key: data_manager

formats.description: IDC request file data-managers/<data_table>/<version>.yaml (current pipeline): one data manager run that builds one data table entry. Validated by schemas/request.schema.json.
formats.record_key: file path data-managers/<data_table>/<version>.yaml (not inside the file)

formats.description: IDC PR #88 all_tables YAML (sync/tool_data_table_conf_to_yaml.py): every row of every data table on a server, keyed by table, with the .loc and conf file it came from. One native record per row.
formats.record_key: table + value + loc_file

formats.description: IDC PR #88 json/<unique_build_id>.json (sync/all_fasta_files_to_refget_store.py): seqcol level 0/1/2 digests of one all_fasta FASTA plus its Galaxy aliases.
formats.record_key: level_0 (seqcol digest) or aliases.galaxy_unique_build_id

formats.description: IDC PR #88 yaml/all_fasta.yml: the same digests for every processed FASTA in one file, keyed by unique_build_id, with a peek at the first sequence instead of the full level 2 arrays.
formats.record_key: unique_build_id (the YAML mapping key)

fields.description: Build key (first column). Stored on every dataset as its 'dbkey'.
fields.notes: Not a header name: the file has no header; name taken from Galaxy's dbkeys.loc sample header '<dbkey>'. read_dbnames() treats an all-digit dbkey as a 'manual' (microbial) build and '?' as 'unspecified'. Lines starting with '#' are skipped.

fields.description: Label shown in the build picker (second column).
fields.notes: UCSC-harvested labels follow 'Species Mon. YYYY (AssemblyName/dbkey) (dbkey)', e.g. 'Human Dec. 2013 (GRCh38/hg38) (hg38)'; this is the only place builds.txt carries the assembly name. Columns after the second are ignored (manual_builds.txt.sample has a third column of name=length pairs).

fields.description: Sequence name.
fields.notes: Unique within one .len file. Naming follows the build: UCSC style for UCSC dbkeys (chr1, chr1_KI270706v1_random); RefSeq accessions for the BRC GCF_000146045.2 (NC_001133.9). The BRC GCF_000001405.40 .len uses UCSC-style names (455 sequences), unlike its accession.

fields.description: Sequence length in bases.
Display name of the build (first item of each pair).
fields.notes: Same text as builds.txt display_name or the __dbkeys__ name. Custom user builds get ' [Custom]' and history .len datasets get ' [History]' appended.

fields.description: dbkey (second item of each pair).
fields.notes: The list merges builds.txt, the __dbkeys__ table, user custom builds and history .len files, so a dbkey can appear more than once. The first pair is always ['unspecified (?)', '?'].

fields.description: The dbkey asked for.
True when the server has reference sequence for this dbkey (a twobit table entry), so sequence can be served.
Sequence names and lengths: array of {chrom, len} read from the dbkey's .len file.
fields.notes: Sorted by Galaxy with a natural sort on the name (split_by_number), NOT in .len or FASTA order, so it cannot give seqcol 'names' order. Paged with query parameters num/chrom/low; the whole list comes back when num is not given. The .len may not match any one FASTA under the same dbkey (hg38 .len lists 711 sequences incl. patches; hg38canon has 25).

fields.description: Paging flag: sequences exist before this page.
fields.notes: Paging only.

fields.description: Paging flag: sequences exist after this page.
fields.notes: Paging only.

fields.description: Paging: line index in the .len file where this page starts.
fields.notes: Paging only.

fields.description: Data table name (e.g. all_fasta, __dbkeys__).
fields.notes: Top-level key of the response, repeated on every native record. Do not confuse with fields[].name (the row's display name).

fields.description: Python class of the table (TabularToolDataTable, RefgenieToolDataTable).
Column names of the table, in order; each row in 'fields' is a list in this order.
Row's unique_build_id (column 'value').
fields.notes: Meant to be unique within a data table on one server (tools store it in workflows), but not enforced: usegalaxy.org serves all_fasta 'hg38canon' twice and usegalaxy.eu serves 'hg38canon' twice with different names. Index tables usually reuse the all_fasta value, but not always (all_fasta 'hg38' points to hg38.fa while bwa_mem and bowtie2 'hg38' point to hg38full).

fields.description: Row's dbkey (column 'dbkey'; absent in __dbkeys__, where value is the dbkey).
fields.notes: Build key: groups several entries (e.g. hg38, hg38canon, hg38female all have dbkey hg38). Not unique. Galaxy uses it to mark datasets as compatible and to link to UCSC. Mostly UCSC database names; newer BRC/VGP entries use RefSeq/GenBank assembly accessions (GCF_000001405.40).

fields.description: Row's display name (column 'name').
fields.notes: Free-text display label. Often embeds species, assembly name and a subset hint ('Canonical', 'Female', 'full'), but is not parsed by Galaxy and differs between servers for the same value.

fields.description: Row's file path (column 'path'), cut to the file name for non-admin callers.
fields.notes: Galaxy strips the directory of the column named 'path' for non-admins (managers/tool_data.py), so this is 'hg38canon.fa', not the CVMFS path. For index tables it is the index file prefix or directory, not a FASTA.

fields.description: __dbkeys__ only: path of the .len file.
fields.notes: Not stripped (only a column literally named 'path' is), so the full server path shows.

fields.description: rnastar_index2x_versioned only: '1' if the index was built with a GTF, else '0'.
rnastar_index2x_versioned only: oldest STAR version that can read the index.
Data table name (<table name=...>). Tools refer to tables by this name.
fields.notes: Several conf files (Galaxy's own, the shed conf, CVMFS byhand/managed/brc/vgp) may each declare the same table; Galaxy merges them if the columns are identical.

fields.description: Lines whose first non-blank character is this are skipped in the .loc files. Default '#'.
'False' makes Galaxy drop rows that exactly repeat another row. Default true.
fields.notes: String in XML; Galaxy reads it with asbool. It removes exact duplicate rows only; two rows with the same value but different names both stay.

fields.description: Table type: 'tabular' (default, .loc files) or 'refgenie' (filled from a refgenie config).
type=refgenie only: refgenie asset whose entries fill the table (fasta, bowtie2_index, ...).
Field separator in the .loc files. Default TAB.
fields.notes: Not used by any table in the collected files.

fields.description: Value written for missing fields. Default ''.
fields.notes: Not used by any table in the collected files.

fields.description: 'true' lets user-defined tools read the table.
fields.notes: Only mentioned in a comment of the Galaxy sample; no table in the collected files sets it.

fields.description: Column names in file order (<columns>value, dbkey, name, path</columns>, split on commas).
fields.notes: A column named 'value' is required. The .loc files themselves carry no column names; this is the only place they are declared.

fields.description: Alternative to <columns>: list of <column name= index= [empty_field_value=]/> attributes.
fields.notes: Not used in the collected files.

fields.description: List of <file> attributes: path (a .loc file, relative to tool_data_path, may use ${__HERE__}), url (fetched at start-up), or from_config (name of a Galaxy config option, e.g. refgenie_config_file).
type=refgenie only: list of <field name= template= [strip=] [column_index=]> with the template text as 'text'.
fields.notes: Templates use the variables of format galaxy_refgenie_table, e.g. ${__REFGENIE_UUID__}.

fields.description: unique_build_id: the identifier tools store in workflows and jobs (column 1).
fields.notes: Meant to be unique within a data table on one server (tools store it in workflows), but not enforced: usegalaxy.org serves all_fasta 'hg38canon' twice and usegalaxy.eu serves 'hg38canon' twice with different names. Index tables usually reuse the all_fasta value, but not always (all_fasta 'hg38' points to hg38.fa while bwa_mem and bowtie2 'hg38' point to hg38full).

fields.description: Build key this entry belongs to (column 2).
fields.notes: Build key: groups several entries (e.g. hg38, hg38canon, hg38female all have dbkey hg38). Not unique. Galaxy uses it to mark datasets as compatible and to link to UCSC. Mostly UCSC database names; newer BRC/VGP entries use RefSeq/GenBank assembly accessions (GCF_000001405.40).

fields.description: Display name shown in tool forms (column 3).
fields.notes: Free-text display label. Often embeds species, assembly name and a subset hint ('Canonical', 'Female', 'full'), but is not parsed by Galaxy and differs between servers for the same value.

fields.description: Absolute path of the FASTA file (column 4).
fields.notes: Server-specific (CVMFS paths here). Data managers write genomes/<dbkey>/<index_type>/<version>/<value>/...; older byhand entries use other layouts. Can contain ${__HERE__}. This is the copy of the sequence collection; the only Galaxy field that points at actual sequence.

fields.description: '1' if built with annotations (--sjdbGTFfile), '0' if not (column 5).
fields.notes: Index build parameter.

fields.description: STAR version that introduced this index format, i.e. the oldest STAR that can use it (column 6).
fields.notes: Index build parameter, e.g. 2.7.4a.

fields.description: dbkey being defined (column 1).
fields.notes: In this table value IS the dbkey; there is no dbkey column. Several .loc files fill it (CVMFS managed dbkeys.loc and dbkeys_ucsc.loc, brc, vgp), so one dbkey can be listed by more than one file.

fields.description: Display name of the dbkey (column 2).
fields.notes: UCSC-derived entries copy the builds.txt label ('Human Dec. 2013 (GRCh38/hg38) (hg38)'); RefSeq-based entries look like 'Homo sapiens (GCF_000001405.40)'.

fields.description: Absolute path of the .len chromosome-length file (column 3).
fields.notes: Defines the coordinate system Galaxy shows for the dbkey. The data manager writes it under genomes/<dbkey>/len/. Can contain ${__HERE__}.

fields.description: Data table the entry is for: the key under 'data_tables'.
fields.notes: Not a literal key inside the entry; the enclosing object key. One output can fill several tables (fetch genome writes all_fasta and __dbkeys__).

fields.description: unique_build_id of the new entry (all_fasta: the sequence_id parameter).
fields.notes: Index data managers default it to the input FASTA's value or dbkey depending on tool version (sam_fasta_index_builder 1.21+galaxy0 defaults to the dbkey), so it can silently differ from the all_fasta value.

fields.description: Build key. Present even in __dbkeys__ entries, where the table has no dbkey column (used only for the target path).
fields.notes: Build key: groups several entries (e.g. hg38, hg38canon, hg38female all have dbkey hg38). Not unique. Galaxy uses it to mark datasets as compatible and to link to UCSC. Mostly UCSC database names; newer BRC/VGP entries use RefSeq/GenBank assembly accessions (GCF_000001405.40).

fields.description: Display name.
fields.notes: Free-text display label. Often embeds species, assembly name and a subset hint ('Canonical', 'Female', 'full'), but is not parsed by Galaxy and differs between servers for the same value.

fields.description: File name or relative path inside the job's output directory.
fields.notes: Relative here; data_manager_conf.xml moves it to ${GALAXY_DATA_MANAGER_DATA_PATH}/genomes/${dbkey}/seq/${path} (all_fasta) or genomes/${dbkey}/<index>/<v>/${value}/ and writes that absolute path into the .loc.

fields.description: __dbkeys__ entries: .len file name, later moved to genomes/${dbkey}/len/.
rnastar entries: '1' if built with a GTF, else '0'.
rnastar entries: STAR index format version.
Identifier Galaxy builds for one refgenie asset: refgenie:<genome>/<asset>:<tag>@<digest>. The sample conf puts it in column 'value'.
fields.notes: Pattern from code: f"refgenie:{genome}/{self.rg_asset}:{tag}@{digest}". No real record collected.

fields.description: refgenie genome name (alias), e.g. hg38. The sample conf puts it in 'dbkey' (and in __dbkeys__ 'value').
fields.notes: No real record collected.

fields.description: refgenie asset tag (e.g. default).
fields.notes: No real record collected.

fields.description: '<genome_description> (refgenie: <genome>@<digest>)' when the genome has a description, else '<genome>/<asset>:<tag>@<digest>'. Goes in 'name'.
fields.notes: No real record collected.

fields.description: Local path of the asset (rgc.seek(genome, asset, tag)). Goes in 'path'.
fields.notes: No real record collected.

fields.description: Asset name (the table's asset= attribute, e.g. fasta).
fields.notes: No real record collected.

fields.description: refgenie asset digest: rgc.id(genome, asset, tag).
fields.notes: A refgenie asset digest, not a seqcol or refget digest. No real record collected.

fields.description: All genome attributes from the refgenie config (includes genome_description).
fields.notes: No real record collected.

fields.description: Function: __REFGENIE_SEEK_KEY__('chrom_sizes') returns the path of another seek key of the same asset; the sample conf uses it for __dbkeys__ len_path.
fields.notes: A callable, not a value. No real record collected.

fields.description: dbkey of the data.
fields.notes: Build key: groups several entries (e.g. hg38, hg38canon, hg38female all have dbkey hg38). Not unique. Galaxy uses it to mark datasets as compatible and to link to UCSC. Mostly UCSC database names; newer BRC/VGP entries use RefSeq/GenBank assembly accessions (GCF_000001405.40).

fields.description: Description incl. taxonomy, version and date (README); becomes the display name.
fields.notes: Empty with comment '# set from UCSC' for UCSC genomes in genomes.yml.

fields.description: Unique id of the data in Galaxy (becomes the all_fasta value / unique_build_id).
Where to fetch the FASTA: 'ucsc', an NCBI accession, or a URL.
fields.notes: Mixed kinds: 'ucsc' means fetch by dbkey from UCSC; NC_021902 is a single-sequence accession, not an assembly accession; URLs are copies.

fields.description: Any DOI for the data.
fields.notes: Empty in every entry collected.

fields.description: Any version information for the data.
fields.notes: Empty in every entry collected.

fields.description: SHA256 of the original downloaded file.
fields.notes: Empty for UCSC entries; set for URL/accession entries in genomes.yml. Example taken from a file under spec/ (spec/idc/genomes.yml, spec/idc/cvmfs_current_managed/cvmfs_managed_genomes.yml).

fields.description: Free text for other information.

fields.description: Data managers (or tags) to run on this genome.
Data manager tags not to run.

fields.notes: Mapping key, not a literal field. genomes.yml 'indexers' lists these names.

fields.description: Tool Shed GUID of the data manager tool incl. version.
Tags (genome, fetch_source, ...) used to select data managers.
Fixed tool parameters for every run; may contain Jinja like '{{ item.id }}'.
Version-pinned Tool Shed GUID of the data manager.

dbkey the new FASTA belongs to.

fields.notes: Provenance of the copy. Example comment in the docs lists ucsc, ncbi, url.

fields.description: UCSC genome database to download (ucsc source).
fields.notes: A UCSC database name (hg38). The data manager fetches <db>.chromFa.tar.gz (or similar) from hgdownload; it says which UCSC release, i.e. assembly plus UCSC naming.

fields.description: NCBI identifier to download (ncbi source).
fields.notes: An assembly accession in the IDC docs example (GCF_000001405.40).

fields.description: unique_build_id to write (all_fasta value; also used by index builders to set their output value).
fields.notes: Leaving it empty lets the tool pick a default (dbkey or input value) - a known source of mismatched values.

fields.description: Display name to write.
fields.notes: Free-text display label. Often embeds species, assembly name and a subset hint ('Canonical', 'Female', 'full'), but is not parsed by Galaxy and differs between servers for the same value.

fields.description: How to order sequences: as_is, lexicographical, gatk, custom.
fields.notes: Changes sequence order and therefore the seqcol digest of the written FASTA.

fields.description: custom sort: ordered list of {identifier: <sequence name>}.
fields.notes: With handle_not_listed_selector: discard this also chooses WHICH sequences are kept, i.e. defines the collection (hg38canon = chr1-22, X, Y, M).

fields.description: custom sort: what to do with sequences not listed (discard, keep_append, keep_prepend).
Expected SHA-256 per file name, as Galaxy lists the entry's files.
fields.notes: Map {file name: sha256}. File-level checksum of the copy; depends on line width and header text, unlike a seqcol digest. Verified for hg38canon.fa: rebuilding from UCSC hg38.chromFa.tar.gz gives this exact sha256.

fields.description: What the data is, for reviewers.
fields.example: Human hg38 (UCSC), canonical chromosomes chr1-22, X, Y, M only

fields.description: DOI of the publication or dataset the data comes from.
fields.notes: In the schema; not set in any collected request.

fields.description: For index builds: the all_fasta request (file stem = value) this build uses as input.
fields.notes: Wires the input only; does not set the output value (docs/genome-indexing.md). Other upstream tables appear as depends_on.<table>.

fields.description: Data table name (the YAML key the row is listed under).
fields.notes: Enclosing key, not a literal field.

fields.description: Row's value column (unique_build_id; in __dbkeys__ the dbkey; in twobit the dbkey).
fields.notes: Meant to be unique within a data table on one server (tools store it in workflows), but not enforced: usegalaxy.org serves all_fasta 'hg38canon' twice and usegalaxy.eu serves 'hg38canon' twice with different names. Index tables usually reuse the all_fasta value, but not always (all_fasta 'hg38' points to hg38.fa while bwa_mem and bowtie2 'hg38' point to hg38full).

fields.description: Row's dbkey column (absent for __dbkeys__, twobit, sam_fa_indexes).
fields.notes: Build key: groups several entries (e.g. hg38, hg38canon, hg38female all have dbkey hg38). Not unique. Galaxy uses it to mark datasets as compatible and to link to UCSC. Mostly UCSC database names; newer BRC/VGP entries use RefSeq/GenBank assembly accessions (GCF_000001405.40).

fields.description: Row's name column.
fields.notes: Free-text display label. Often embeds species, assembly name and a subset hint ('Canonical', 'Female', 'full'), but is not parsed by Galaxy and differs between servers for the same value.

fields.description: Row's path column (full server path).
fields.notes: Unlike the public API, full paths.

fields.description: __dbkeys__ rows: .len file path.
rnastar rows: '1' or '0'.
rnastar rows: STAR index version.
sam_fa_indexes rows: always 'index' in practice.
fields.notes: Legacy table used by htseq_count and bamtools (PR #88 README).

fields.description: The .loc file this row was read from (added by the script).
fields.notes: Shows which repository serves the row (byhand, managed, brc, vgp on CVMFS).

fields.description: The tool_data_table_conf.xml that declared the .loc file (added by the script).

fields.notes: Computed from names and sequences only (lengths are not inherent in the current seqcol schema): checked by recomputing phiX174. Same FASTA content and order give the same digest on any server.

seqcol level 1: digest of the sorted sequences array (order-free content id).

Sequence lengths, same order.
